campaign.zc1.description:
Fire and Smoke, peal of swords and whistle of arrows...
Many years have passed since those glorious battles.
Life is more or less peaceful now. All clans and groups licked their wounds.
But what is a life without fighting!?
campaign.zc1.name: In the Wake of Gods
campaign.zc2.description:
He is called the Samaritan. 
Nobody knows his real power. 
Please play and discover his history.

by Bruno
campaign.zc2.name: The Samaritan
campaign.zc3.description:
Your name is Nailag Ciad.
You have always dreamed of becoming an adventurer,
and now that you have reached adulthood,
your dream seems to be coming true. 
But how does one start being an adventurer?
campaign.zc3.name: A Life of A-d-v-e-n-t-u-r-e
campaign.zc4.description: Xsi had the order to spy the humans for the Necromancer. But she wasn´t lucky. The humans realised her plans, hunted and prisonded her in a small valley. Now it`s on you to bring Xsi back home to the Necromancer. All maps are planed to play "expert". If you want choose your difficulty!
campaign.zc4.name: Evil Way Home
